property_summary: For any admissible initialization arguments, a correctly initialized pool stores the provided NFT contract as its nft, so ERC721(c.nft()) behaves like a live token contract (balanceOf does not revert); the mutant stores address(0) as nft, so querying balanceOf on c.nft() reverts, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Assign address(0) to nft instead of the provided _nft parameter.
